content: अन्यतर {%a.%} (declined like a pronoun) One of the two (persons or things), either of the two (with <ab>gen.</ab>); तयोर्मुनिकुमारयोरन्यतरः <ls>K. 151</ls>; सन्तः परीक्ष्यान्यतरद् भजन्ते <ls>M. 1. 2</ls> the one or the other; अन्यतरा युवयोरागच्छतु <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 111</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 171</ls>; other, different; अन्यतर--अन्यतर the one--the other; अन्यतरस्याम् (<ab>loc.</ab> of ˚रा) either way, in both ways, optionally; frequently used by Pāṇini in his Sūtras in the sense of वा or विभाषा; हृकोरन्यतरस्याम्, आत्मनेपदेष्वन्यतरस्याम् <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab>
